name: Painting Company - AI Morning Report Agent (No Pumble API Key Demo)

parameters.jsCode: const x=$json; return [{json:{status:'READY', generatedAt:x.generatedAt, formattedReport:x.formattedReport, escalationRequired:(x.report?.escalationItems?.length??0)>0, report:x.report}}];

options.systemMessage:
You classify painting jobs.

Assign each job to ONE category:
Escalation > Stalled > Attention > Moved.

Escalation = safety or major scope change.
Stalled = no activity for 24+ hours.
Attention = customer, weather, material, or scheduling issue.
Moved = measurable progress.

Return ONLY JSON.
No explanation.
No markdown.
No text before or after JSON.

Use exactly this structure:

{
  "summary": "",
  "jobsMoved": [],
  "stalledJobs": [],
  "needsAttention": [],
  "escalationItems": [],
  "metrics": {
    "jobsReviewed": 0,
    "jobsMoved": 0,
    "stalled": 0,
    "needsAttention": 0,
    "escalations": 0
  }
}

Never duplicate a job.
Use only the supplied data.
